textbookText: Circle the correct alternative of the following questions
1. Which of the following is correct alternative based on the given two statements?
Statement 1 : During Scientific experiment the change made by the researcher is the dependent variable and subsequent
change in dable is the independent variable.
Statement 2. While observing the effect of sunlight on the growth and development of the plant, the amount of sunlight is
the independent variables and the height or growth of the plant is the dependent variable
i) Both statement 1 and statement 2 are true.
ii) Both statement 1 and statement 2 are false
iii) Statement 1 is incorrect but statement 2 is correct
iv) Statement 1 is correct but statement 2 is incorrect
Ans:- iii) Statement 1 is incorrect but statement 2 is correct
